title: Every rehearsal, my one line comes out of the wings in my own voice
description:
I joined a little playhouse to meet people, and the director gave me one line in the last scene. Every run of rehearsal week, I froze on my tape mark.

And every run, my line came out of the dark wings anyway. In my own voice. One curtain nearer each time.

A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender. It's made up.
pin: Did you count the chalk marks on the brick wall behind the curtains? There were only seven of us.
